name: A Call To Mars
source:
A signal from Mars has all the nations of Earth teaming up to pay a visit to the Red Planet. Well-trained and long-pampered representatives from each nation came together to travel through space: 5 were selected on how well they would represent their nation and their planet in the hopes of impressing this new Mars society. And to Mars they went. Upon arriving, they found a surreal desert out of a dream, and no intelligent life to be found. These five adults, many poorly developed in regards to maturity, identity, and attitude, many from completely separate or rival cultures, are forced to survive together on a planet with unknown terrors and no comfort in familiarity.

Created for [url=http://www.antholojam.com/]Antholojam 1: Golden Era of Sci Fi[/url].
translation:
来自火星的信号让地球各国联手前往这颗红色星球。各国派出训练有素、长期受到优待的代表，共同踏上太空旅程：五人因最能代表自己的国家与星球而入选，希望给全新的火星社会留下深刻印象。于是，他们前往火星。抵达后，映入眼帘的是梦境般超现实的沙漠，却不见任何智慧生命。这五名成年人中，有许多人在成熟度、自我认知和态度上都不够完善；他们来自彼此完全不同甚至互相敌对的文化，如今被迫在一颗充满未知恐怖、无法借熟悉事物获得慰藉的星球上共同求生。

为[url=http://www.antholojam.com/]Antholojam 1：科幻黄金时代[/url]制作。
